title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement Strategy, Data Center
description: Job Type: Full-time | Location: Fort Worth | Department: Procurement | Reporting to: VP, Data Center Procurement | Work Location Type: #remote The Senior Manager, Global Procurement Strategy will work directly with the VP of Data Center Procurement to shape, drive, and scale the global procurement strategy supporting IREN's expanding data center portfolio. This role blends strategic thinking with strong analytical rigor — translating business priorities, market intelligence, and performance data into the frameworks, plans, and materials that guide procurement decisions across regions. Operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, the Senior Manager will play a central role in building procurement into a scalable, globally consistent function, while acting as a trusted right hand to the VP on strategic priorities, executive communications, and cross-regional coordination. IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC. With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in. Global Procurement Strategy & Planning Partner directly with the VP to develop, refine, and operationalize the global procurement strategy across data center categories and regions. Translate strategic priorities into structured plans, frameworks, and roadmaps that regional and category teams can execute against. Track progress against strategic initiatives and flag risks, gaps, or resourcing needs to leadership. Expansion & Scaling Suppor
